oracle.statement: the listing is a faithful registry of create/drop ACKs, sampled immediately at each ACK: MR1 post-create prefix scope lists exactly {A,B,C}; MR2 post-drop of B lists exactly {A,C} with describe answering 404 for B and 200 for control A; MR3 post-recreate lists {A,B,C} with B exactly once - membership deviation, duplicate row from lifecycle churn, or list/describe disagreement = Type4_StateLogicViolation; 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3; transport failure with healthy /healthz or setup-premise failure = SCRIPT_ERROR
